visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man stands centrally, framed by a decorative esports-themed border. He has dark hair, rectangular glasses, and wears a navy blue undershirt beneath a white and navy 'Flash Wolves' jersey featuring a Red Bull logo. The background is a flat, neutral gray. Large captions in Traditional Chinese appear at the bottom center of the frame. (2) He speaks calmly, his mouth moving clearly while his eyes remain focused on the interviewer. He occasionally blinks and shifts his weight slightly. Large white text overlays emphasize key achievements like 'World Champion' and 'FMVP' over his chest area. (3) The speaker gestures more with his hands, clasping them together, as he discusses his teammates. An inset circular graphic featuring another player appears on the left side of his chest. The lighting is bright and even studio lighting. (4) In a sudden burst of energy, he raises both arms high, forming a celebratory 'YAY' gesture while looking excited. He then turns away slightly to his left with a triumphant smile. The camera remains static throughout.
